meta.name: Doll's House
meta.description: Doll’s House is a Hindi play starring Swastika Mukherjee, Subhrajyoti Barat, Ratnabali Bhattacharya and Dibyendu Bhattacharya. Keya is a pampered wife and her husband, Shubhodeep, treats her like his most prized possession. All decisions are made by Shubhodeep and the only time Keya lies to her husband is when she takes help from Bansi, her husband’s colleague. Will Bansi spill the beans and put her marriage at stake?
